entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Viri Galilaei Church is a Greek Orthodox church located at the northern peak of the Mount of Olives in eastern Jerusalem, Israel. It is part of the Monastery of Little Galilee on the Mount of Olives, which belongs to the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate of Jerusalem, and serves as the private residence of the Patriarch.
